e.title: ClaimScope 理赔严重度基准：一份把「模型没跑赢常数均值」当作主要发现的公开数据复现研究——数据钉在不可变修订与 SHA-256 校验和上，原始数据与模型产物都不入库
e.title_en: ClaimScope, a claim severity benchmark: a public-data replication study whose main finding is that the model did not beat the constant mean, with data pinned to an immutable revision and SHA-256 checksums and both the raw data and the fitted artefacts excluded from Git
e.title_hk: ClaimScope 理賠嚴重度基準：一份把「模型沒跑贏常數均值」當作主要發現的公開數據復現研究——數據釘在不可變修訂與 SHA-256 校驗和上，原始數據與模型產物都不入庫
e.summary: 一个用公开数据做的理赔成本与严重度研究：它问的是保单特征能否估计**一笔已存在理赔的记录金额**并识别相对高成本的理赔，而**原本的「早期成本／最终成本」设想被主动收窄**，因为公开数据源无法确立首次报案时点的特征可得性或最终结算的成熟度；其主要发现被写在最前面——有限保单特征提供的预测信号很弱，**验证环节选中了常数均值严重度基线**，高成本分类仅略高于基准发生率，并自述这是一份「带透明负面结果的可复现研究，而不是一个生产用保险决策系统」；数据取自已固定到不可变修订与 SHA-256 校验和的公开包（本次运行 677,991 张保单与 26,444 条理赔记录），并明确说明「一行仍是一条严重度记录，金额未被汇总为保单级损失」；工作流为「固定来源 → 质量检查 → SQLite → SQL 连接 → 按保单分组切分 → 仅用训练集预处理 → 验证选择 → 留出评估 → 保存管线 → FastAPI 推理」，其中「按保单分组切分」与「仅用训练集预处理」是防泄漏的两处；仓库刻意不用 notebook，理由是「可执行模块能在没有隐藏 notebook 状态的情况下重新生成摘要与图」；结果表、图、数据质量报告与计数对账均入库，而原始数据、连接后的行、单条预测与训练产物均被排除
e.summary_hk: 一個用公開數據做的理賠成本與嚴重度研究：它問的是保單特徵能否估計**一筆已存在理賠的記錄金額**並識別相對高成本的理賠，而**原本的「早期成本／最終成本」設想被主動收窄**，因為公開數據源無法確立首次報案時點的特徵可得性或最終結算的成熟度；其主要發現被寫在最前面——有限保單特徵提供的預測信號很弱，**驗證環節選中了常數均值嚴重度基線**，高成本分類僅略高於基準發生率，並自述這是一份「帶透明負面結果的可復現研究，而不是一個生產用保險決策系統」；數據取自已固定到不可變修訂與 SHA-256 校驗和的公開包（本次運行 677,991 張保單與 26,444 條理賠記錄），並明確說明「一行仍是一條嚴重度記錄，金額未被匯總為保單級損失」；工作流為「固定來源 → 質量檢查 → SQLite → SQL 連接 → 按保單分組切分 → 僅用訓練集預處理 → 驗證選擇 → 留出評估 → 保存管線 → FastAPI 推理」，其中「按保單分組切分」與「僅用訓練集預處理」是防洩漏的兩處；倉庫刻意不用 notebook，理由是「可執行模組能在沒有隱藏 notebook 狀態的情況下重新生成摘要與圖」；結果表、圖、數據質量報告與計數對賬均入庫，而原始數據、連接後的行、單條預測與訓練產物均被排除
e.summary_en: A study of claim cost and severity using public data: it asks whether policy characteristics can estimate the recorded amount of an existing claim and identify relatively high-cost claims, while the original early-cost versus final-cost idea was deliberately narrowed because the public source cannot establish first-report feature timing or final settlement maturity; its main finding comes first — limited policy features provide weak predictive signal, validation selected the constant-mean severity baseline, and high-cost classification performs only modestly above prevalence — and it describes itself as a reproducible investigation with transparent negative results rather than a production insurance decision system; the data comes from a public package pinned to an immutable revision and SHA-256 checksums (this run uses 677,991 policies and 26,444 claim records), with the explicit note that a row remains a severity record and amounts are not aggregated into policy-level losses; the workflow runs pinned source, quality checks, SQLite, SQL join, policy-group split, train-only preprocessing, validation selection, held-out evaluation, saved pipelines and FastAPI inference, where the policy-group split and train-only preprocessing are the two leakage controls; the repository deliberately avoids notebooks because executable modules regenerate the summaries and plots without hidden notebook state; and result tables, figures, data-quality reports and count reconciliation are committed while raw data, joined rows, individual predictions and trained artefacts are excluded
e.body:
**claimscope-benchmark**（ClaimScope，仓库 `ThomsonThomas-V/claimscope`）**是一份用**公开数据**做的理赔成本与严重度研究**：**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 210 KB、创建于 2026-09-08、最后推送 2026-09-08、无 topics**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，创建与推送均落在解冻窗口之后**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 在 70 个条目中实测不存在——属本站记录的「完全未声明」形态）**；**README 实测 10,066 字节（英语）**；**仓库实测共 70 个条目**。**其自述逐字为**：**「**Insurance Claim Cost & Severity Intelligence** — an independent data-science portfolio project built with public data. **No affiliation with Allianz; no proprietary data, pricing, underwriting process, or branding is reproduced.**」**。本条目属于本轮主题**「只报别人能重算的数」**中的**第三种，也是四条里唯一**把「我的模型输给了一个常数」当作主要发现发布**的一条**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其主要发现写在 README 最前面，且结论是**负面的****——**逐字为**：**「**Main finding:** limited policy features provide **weak predictive signal**. **Validation selected the constant mean severity baseline**; high-cost classification performs **modestly above prevalence**. This repository demonstrates **a reproducible investigation with transparent negative results, not a production insurance decision system**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① 「**验证环节选中了常数均值严重度基线**」**——**即**按流程走完模型选择之后，选出来的是「就用平均值」****（**⭐ 对做建模的同学，这是一条**很罕见也很值得学的结论形态**：**多数项目不会发布「我的候选模型全部输给了一个常数」**；**⭐ 而它与第 336 轮 [[inforsight]] 的「六代模型、五次失败、一次成功」同属**把失败留在记录里****）；**② **「高成本分类仅略高于基准发生率」**——**即**它给出的不是「提升多少倍」而是**与发生率相比只高一点****；**③ **「可复现研究…而不是一个生产用保险决策系统」**——**与本轮 [[storm-parametric-corroboration]]、[[ballast-parametric-cover]] 的「不是什么」写法同源**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它把**原本的研究问题收窄了**，并把收窄的理由写成了一条**数据可得性判断****——**逐字为**：**「ClaimScope asks whether policy characteristics can estimate the **recorded amount of an existing claim** and identify relatively high-cost claims. **The original early/final-cost idea was narrowed because the public source cannot establish first-report feature timing or final settlement maturity.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**原本想做「早期成本 vs 最终成本」，但**因为公开数据源无法确立「首次报案时点上的特征可得性」与「最终结算的成熟度」，故主动收窄到「已存在理赔的记录金额」****——**⭐ 这两条恰好是本站连续多轮反复出现的两种失败**（**时间泄漏**与**结算成熟度**）；**⭐ 而它的处理是**改问题**而不是**假装数据支持原问题****（**可与第 336 轮 [[inforsight]] 的「时间泄漏会悄悄抬高准确率」并读**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **数据来源的可重算性做得比本站已收多数条目更硬**——**逐字为**：**「Original `freMTPL2freq` and `freMTPL2sev` files from [CASdatasets](…), **pinned to an immutable repository revision and SHA-256 checksums**. This run uses **677,991 policies and 26,444 claim records**, linked by policy ID. **A row remains a severity record; amounts are not aggregated into policy-level losses.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **钉到不可变修订 + SHA-256 校验和****（**⭐ 即**别人可以确认拿到的是同一份字节**——**本词条认为这是「别人能重算」这一要求的**基础层****）；**② **677,991 张保单与 26,444 条理赔记录按保单 ID 关联**；**③ **「一行仍是一条严重度记录，金额未被汇总为保单级损失」**——**⭐ 这是一条**单位与口径声明****，**它确定了后续所有指标的含义**（**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**该声明在代码中是否成立**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其工作流逐字，且其中两处正是**防泄漏措施****——**逐字为**：**「Pinned source → quality checks → SQLite → SQL join → **policy-group split** → **train-only preprocessing** → validation selection → held-out evaluation → saved pipelines → FastAPI inference」**⭐⭐⭐ **两处值得记**：**① **按**保单**分组切分**（**而不是按行随机切分**）**——**⭐ 即**同一张保单的多条理赔记录不会被分到训练集与测试集两边****（**这正是第 336 轮 [[inforsight]] 用**聚类自助法**处理同一问题的同一关切**）；**② **预处理**只在训练集上拟合****——**⭐ 即**编码、缩放等步骤不接触验证与留出数据****（**⭐ 对做建模的同学，这两步是**最容易漏、也最不容易从指标上发现**的泄漏来源**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **它刻意不用 notebook，理由是一句很实在的话**——**逐字为**：**「**An EDA notebook is unnecessary: executable modules regenerate the summaries and plots without hidden notebook state.** SQLite provides real joins, indexes, count reconciliation, and regional/vehicle-age summaries.」**⭐⭐⭐ **「可执行模块能在没有隐藏 notebook 状态的情况下重新生成摘要与图」**——**⭐ 即**拒绝 notebook 的理由是**隐藏状态**（**单元格可以按任意顺序执行、中间变量不落在任何可复核的地方**），**而它给出的替代是**模块 + 真实 SQL 连接 + 计数对账****（**⭐ 实测其 `sql/` 与 `reports/count_reconciliation.csv` 都存在**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **其「哪些入库、哪些不入库」的界线逐字，且两侧都很具体**——**逐字为**：**「The pinned package declares GPL (>= 2). **Raw files, joined rows, individual predictions, and trained artifacts are excluded from Git.** See the provenance and usage record before redistribution.」**；**以及** **「Outcomes are **positive recorded amounts in source monetary units**; **currency and final settlement status are not independently verified**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **两处值得记**：**① **被排除的四类**（**原始文件、连接后的行、单条预测、训练产物**）**——**⭐ 即**结论与汇总指标入库，**而**任何可以反推到个体的中间物**都不入库****；**② **它指出结果的单位是「源货币单位的正记录金额」**，**且**「币种与最终结算状态未获独立核实」****——**⭐ 这些恰恰是保险数据分析里**最容易静默出错**的两处（**可与 [[claimscope-benchmark]] 本身的「按保单分组」关切并读**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **实测仓库里确实有它声称的那些**结论与对账产物****——**逐名为**：**`reports/evaluation.md`、`reports/eda.json`、`reports/data_quality.json`、`reports/count_reconciliation.csv`、`reports/classification_uncertainty.json`、`reports/gamma_coefficients.csv`、`reports/high_cost_importance.csv`、以及 `reports/figures/` 下 `heldout_diagnostics.png` 与 `training_costs.png`**；**`docs/` 下七份文档**（**`findings.md`、`methodology.md`、`dataset_selection.md`、`engineering.md`、`project_status.md`、`git_workflow.md`、`review_guide.md`**）；**`examples/request.json` 与 `examples/response.json`**（**实测存在**）；**`models/.gitkeep`**（**即模型目录被清空、只留占位**）；**`pyproject.toml`**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **`docs/methodology.md` 逐字被 README 描述为「方法论与**泄漏登记表**」（methodology and leakage register）**——**⭐ 即**泄漏被当作一份**要登记的清单**而不是一件要小心的事****；**② **`reports/count_reconciliation.csv`**——**计数对账**（**⭐ 即**它把「两边的行数对得上吗」做成了一个入库的产物****）；**③ **`models/.gitkeep`**——**模型目录**实测为空占位**，**与第 ⑥ 点的「训练产物不入库」一致**（**⭐ 本词条**已实测**这一点**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **其复现命令逐字，且区分了 Windows 与 Linux/macOS 两套，并给出**锁定的依赖与版本****——**逐字含** **「Tested with **Python 3.12.14**.」**、**`pip install -r requirements-lock.txt`**、**`python -m claimscope.cli run`**、**`python -m pytest -q`**、**以及** **`python scripts/verify_release.py --rebuild`**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **明确写出测试所用的 Python 版本**；**② **用**锁定的依赖文件**而非 `requirements.txt`**；**③ ⭐ **`scripts/verify_release.py --rebuild`**——**⭐ 即**存在一个**重跑并校验发布**的脚本****（**⚠️ 本词条**未运行它**——**见标注 ③**）。**⑨ ⭐ **其自述定位与「先读什么」的引导也值得记**：**README 逐字给出**「Review first」**一节**，**依次指向 `docs/findings.md`（**发现与解读**）、`reports/evaluation.md`（**生成的模型对照**）、`docs/dataset_selection.md`（**数据集可行性决策**）、`docs/methodology.md`（**方法论与泄漏登记表**）、`docs/review_guide.md`（**代码走读与面试问题**）**⭐⭐ **其中两处值得单独记**：**① **「数据集可行性决策」被单独列为一篇文档****——**⭐ 即**「这份数据能不能支持这个问题」是一个**有记录的决策**，而不是一个默认假设**；**② **`review_guide.md` 逐字含「代码走读与**面试问题**」**——**⭐ 这与它自述「portfolio project」一致**，**本词条如实记入：该仓库**同时是一份求职作品集****。**⑩ ⭐ **其非关联声明逐字且具体**：**「No affiliation with Allianz; **no proprietary data, pricing, underwriting process, or branding is reproduced.**」**——**⭐ 四项否定（无关联、无专有数据、无定价、无核保流程、无品牌）**——**本词条如实记入**（**⚠️ 其数据集中出现的公司名并未被本词条转述**）。**⑪ ⭐ 可与本站公开数据、频率—强度与准备金条目并读**：[[casdatasets]]、[[fremtpl2]]、[[fremtpl2-python-tutorial]]、[[claim-frequency]]、[[insurance-frequency-severity]]、[[insurance-severity]]、[[motor-loss-reserving-dl]]、[[loss-models-computer-labs]]、[[insurance-calibration]]、[[verified-reserving]]、[[rf-pipeline-calibration-reserving]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **许可实测为**无****——**`LICENSE` 在 70 个条目中实测不存在**，**README 亦无许可章节**，**属本站记录的「完全未声明」形态**；**⚠️ 且它自述所用第三方包**声明 GPL (>= 2)**，**并要求读者**在再分发前先读其来源与使用记录****——**本词条据此提示：**该仓库的代码与结果产物的可复用性需先向作者确认授权，而其**数据的许可另受上游包约束****。**② ⚠️⚠️ **本次**未读任何代码、未运行任何命令、未读论文式的任何文档内容****——**故其「验证选中常数均值基线」「高成本分类略高于基准发生率」这一主要发现、其工作流、其防泄漏两处、其数据来源与钉定方式，**全部只记录为 README 如此声明****；**⭐ 本词条**已实测的只是**这些机制各自对应的**文件确实存在****（**`docs/` 七份、`reports/` 下八个文件与两张图、`examples/request.json` 与 `response.json`、`models/.gitkeep`、`pyproject.toml`、`sql/`、`scripts/`、`tests/`**）**——**⚠️ 但**文件存在不等于其中的内容与结论如 README 所述**；**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**其任何指标数字**——**⚠️ README**未在本次所读部分给出具体数值**（**如 AUC、提升度、或高成本分类的具体指标**），**⚠️ 而本次**未读 `reports/evaluation.md` 或 `docs/findings.md`**，**故**本词条**不转述任何指标值**；**⚠️ 亦**未运行 `scripts/verify_release.py --rebuild`、未运行任何测试、未安装任何依赖**。**④ ⚠️⭐ **未核实**「验证选中常数均值基线」这一结论的**程序正确性****——**⚠️ 这恰恰是本条最值得被检验的一点**：**「基线赢了」既可能是**诚实的负面结果**，也可能是**流程或特征工程有缺陷**（**例如预处理错误、切分错误、或目标变量定义不当**）；**⚠️ 本次**未读 `docs/methodology.md` 的泄漏登记表、未读任何建模代码、未查其模型对照产物**，**故**不主张**该结论成立**，**也**不主张**其不成立**（**⭐ 本词条**只记录作者如此报告**）。**⑤ ⚠️⭐ **未核实**「按保单分组切分」与「仅用训练集预处理」在代码中是否确实成立**（**⚠️ 本次未读任何源码或管线配置**）；**⭐ 这是本条目第二个需要后续核实之处**（**因为**若这两处不成立，则「基线赢了」这一结论的含义会变**）。**⑥ ⚠️⭐ **未核实**其数据来源与使用边界**——**⚠️ 本次**未查 CASdatasets 的许可条款、未核实该 GPL 声明、未核实其是否确实只在公开数据上运行**；**本词条**不主张**其数据使用已合规**。**⑦ ⚠️ **本次核实的是**仓库元数据、README（10,066 字节）全文、以及仓库全部 70 个条目的文件清单**；**⚠️ 本次通读了 README 的**开篇、主要发现、Review first 列表、数据集一节、工作流与仓库结构、复现命令与「无需 notebook」的理由****；⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安装 Python、未运行任何命令或测试、**未读任何源码、未读 `docs/` 下任何文档、未读 `reports/` 下任何文件（含 `evaluation.md` 与 `count_reconciliation.csv`）、未读 `sql/` 下任何查询、未读任何脚本、未打开任何图****。**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核实**其与任何实体（含其非关联声明中提到者）的关系**，**亦**未核实**该研究是课程作业、个人项目还是受托工作**；**本词条**不主张**其具有任何审计或学术权威性**。**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **本词条**不主张**其「有限保单特征信号很弱」这一结论适用于任何其他数据集、市场或险种**——**⚠️ 其结论受其数据源（公开的法国机动车保险数据）、其目标变量定义（记录金额）与其特征集约束**；**亦**不主张**任何模型不可用于保险定价或核保决策**。**⑩ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、创建与推送均为 2026-09-08**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、正确性或已被采用**；**⑪ ⭐ 无 topics**；**⑫ **README **claimscope-benchmark**（ClaimScope，倉庫 `ThomsonThomas-V/claimscope`）**是一份用**公開數據**做的理賠成本與嚴重度研究**：**實測 ★0、fork 0、主語言 Python、體量 210 KB、創建於 2026-09-08、最後推送 2026-09-08、無 topics**（**均落在解凍窗口之後**）；**⚠️ 實測無任何許可文件（`LICENSE` 在 70 個條目中實測不存在——屬「完全未聲明」形態）**；**README 實測 10,066 位元組（英語）**；**倉庫實測共 70 個條目**。**其自述逐字為**：**「**Insurance Claim Cost & Severity Intelligence** — an independent data-science portfolio project built with public data. **No affiliation with Allianz; no proprietary data, pricing, underwriting process, or branding is reproduced.**」**。本條目屬本輪主題**「只報別人能重算的數」**中的**第三種，也是四條裡唯一**把「我的模型輸給了一個常數」當作主要發現發布**的一條**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其主要發現寫在 README 最前面，且結論是**負面的****——**逐字為**：**「**Main finding:** limited policy features provide **weak predictive signal**. **Validation selected the constant mean severity baseline**; high-cost classification performs **modestly above prevalence**. This repository demonstrates **a reproducible investigation with transparent negative results, not a production insurance decision system**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處值得記**：**① 「**驗證環節選中了常數均值嚴重度基線**」——**即**按流程走完模型選擇之後，選出來的是「就用平均值」****（**⭐ 多數項目不會發布「我的候選模型全部輸給了一個常數」；**而它與第 336 輪 [[inforsight]] 的「六代模型、五次失敗、一次成功」同屬**把失敗留在記錄裡****）；**② **「高成本分類僅略高於基準發生率」**——**即**它給出的不是「提升多少倍」而是**與發生率相比只高一點****；**③ **「可復現研究…而不是一個生產用保險決策系統」**——**與本輪其餘兩條的「不是什麼」寫法同源**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它把**原本的研究問題收窄了**，並把理由寫成一條**數據可得性判斷****——**逐字為**：**「**The original early/final-cost idea was narrowed because the public source cannot establish first-report feature timing or final settlement maturity.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**原本想做「早期成本 vs 最終成本」，但**因為公開數據源無法確立「首次報案時點上的特徵可得性」與「最終結算的成熟度」，故主動收窄到「已存在理賠的記錄金額」****——**⭐ 這兩條恰好是本站連續多輪反覆出現的兩種失敗（**時間洩漏**與**結算成熟度**）；**而它的處理是**改問題**而不是**假裝數據支持原問題****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **數據來源的可重算性做得比本站已收多數條目更硬**——**逐字為**：**「Original `freMTPL2freq` and `freMTPL2sev` files from [CASdatasets](…), **pinned to an immutable repository revision and SHA-256 checksums**. This run uses **677,991 policies and 26,444 claim records**, linked by policy ID. **A row remains a severity record; amounts are not aggregated into policy-level losses.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處值得記**：**① **釘到不可變修訂 + SHA-256 校驗和****（**⭐ 即**別人可以確認拿到的是同一份字節**——**這是「別人能重算」的**基礎層****）；**② **677,991 張保單與 26,444 條理賠記錄按保單 ID 關聯**；**③ **「一行仍是一條嚴重度記錄，金額未被匯總為保單級損失」**——**⭐ 一條**單位與口徑聲明****，**它確定了後續所有指標的含義****。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其工作流逐字，其中兩處正是**防洩漏措施****——**逐字為**：**「Pinned source → quality checks → SQLite → SQL join → **policy-group split** → **train-only preprocessing** → validation selection → held-out evaluation → saved pipelines → FastAPI inference」**⭐⭐⭐ **兩處值得記**：**① **按**保單**分組切分**（**而不是按行隨機切分**）——**⭐ 即**同一張保單的多條理賠記錄不會被分到訓練集與測試集兩邊****（**這正是第 336 輪 [[inforsight]] 用**聚類自助法**處理同一問題的同一關切**）；**② **預處理**只在訓練集上擬合****——**⭐ 這兩步是**最容易漏、也最不容易從指標上發現**的洩漏來源****。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **它刻意不用 notebook，理由是一句很實在的話**——**逐字為**：**「**An EDA notebook is unnecessary: executable modules regenerate the summaries and plots without hidden notebook state.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「可執行模組能在沒有隱藏 notebook 狀態的情況下重新生成摘要與圖」**——**⭐ 即**拒絕 notebook 的理由是**隱藏狀態****（**單元格可以按任意順序執行、中間變量不落在任何可複核的地方**），**而替代方案是**模組 + 真實 SQL 連接 + 計數對賬****（**⭐ 實測其 `sql/` 與 `reports/count_reconciliation.csv` 都存在**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **「哪些入庫、哪些不入庫」的界線逐字**：**「Raw files, joined rows, individual predictions, and trained artifacts are excluded from Git.」**；**「Outcomes are **positive recorded amounts in source monetary units**; **currency and final settlement status are not independently verified**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **兩處值得記**：**① **被排除的四類（原始文件、連接後的行、單條預測、訓練產物）**——**⭐ 即**結論與匯總指標入庫，**而**任何可以反推到個體的中間物**都不入庫****；**② **它指出結果的單位是「源貨幣單位的正記錄金額」，且**「幣種與最終結算狀態未獲獨立核實」****——**⭐ 這些恰恰是保險數據分析裡**最容易靜默出錯**的兩處**。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **實測倉庫裡確實有它聲稱的那些**結論與對賬產物****——**逐名為**：**`reports/evaluation.md`、`reports/eda.json`、`reports/data_quality.json`、`reports/count_reconciliation.csv`、`reports/classification_uncertainty.json`、`reports/gamma_coefficients.csv`、`reports/high_cost_importance.csv`、以及 `reports/figures/` 下 `heldout_diagnostics.png` 與 `training_costs.png`**；**`docs/` 下七份文檔**（**`findings.md`、`methodology.md`、`dataset_selection.md`、`engineering.md`、`project_status.md`、`git_workflow.md`、`review_guide.md`**）；**`examples/request.json` 與 `examples/response.json`**；**`models/.gitkeep`**；**`pyproject.toml`**⭐⭐ **三處值得記**：**① **`docs/methodology.md` 逐字被描述為「方法論與**洩漏登記表**」**——**⭐ 即**洩漏被當作一份**要登記的清單**而不是一件要小心的事****；**② **`reports/count_reconciliation.csv`**——**計數對賬**（**⭐ 即**把「兩邊的行數對得上嗎」做成了一個入庫的產物****）；**③ **`models/.gitkeep`**——**模型目錄**實測為空佔位**，**與第 ⑥ 點一致****。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **其復現命令逐字，區分 Windows 與 Linux/macOS 兩套，並給出**鎖定的依賴與版本****——**逐字含** **「Tested with **Python 3.12.14**.」**、**`pip install -r requirements-lock.txt`**、**`python -m claimscope.cli run`**、**`python -m pytest -q`**、**`python scripts/verify_release.py --rebuild`**⭐⭐ **三處值得記**：**① 明確寫出測試所用的 Python 版本**；**② 用**鎖定的依賴文件****；**③ ⭐ **`scripts/verify_release.py --rebuild`**——**⭐ 即**存在一個**重跑並校驗發布**的腳本****。**⑨ ⭐ **其「先讀什麼」引導值得記**：**README 逐字給出**「Review first」**一節**，**依次指向 `docs/findings.md`（**發現與解讀**）、`reports/evaluation.md`（**生成的模型對照**）、`docs/dataset_selection.md`（**數據集可行性決策**）、`docs/methodology.md`（**方法論與洩漏登記表**）、`docs/review_guide.md`（**代碼走讀與面試問題**）**⭐⭐ **兩處值得單獨記**：**① **「數據集可行性決策」被單獨列為一篇文檔****——**⭐ 即**「這份數據能不能支持這個問題」是一個**有記錄的決策****；**② **`review_guide.md` 逐字含「代碼走讀與**面試問題**」**——**⭐ 這與它自述 portfolio project 一致，**本詞條如實記入：該倉庫**同時是一份求職作品集****。**⑩ ⭐ **其非關聯聲明逐字且具體**：**「No affiliation with Allianz; **no proprietary data, pricing, underwriting process, or branding is reproduced.**」**——**本詞條如實記入**（**⚠️ 其數據集中出現的公司名並未被本詞條轉述**）。**⑪ ⭐ 可與 [[casdatasets]]、[[fremtpl2]]、[[fremtpl2-python-tutorial]]、[[claim-frequency]]、[[insurance-frequency-severity]]、[[insurance-severity]]、[[motor-loss-reserving-dl]]、[[loss-models-computer-labs]]、[[insurance-calibration]]、[[verified-reserving]]、[[rf-pipeline-calibration-reserving]] 並讀**。

**claimscope-benchmark** (ClaimScope, repository `ThomsonThomas-V/claimscope`) **is a study of claim cost and severity built on public data**: **measured ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 210 KB repository, created 2026-09-08 and last pushed 2026-09-08, no topics** (**all GitHub API measurements, both after the thaw window**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file at all (`LICENSE` absent among the 70 entries — the "no statement whatever" form)**; **the README measures 10,066 bytes and is in English**; **the repository measures 70 entries in total**. **Its self-description reads verbatim**: **"**Insurance Claim Cost & Severity Intelligence** — an independent data-science portfolio project built with public data. **No affiliation with [[allianz|Allianz]]; no proprietary data, pricing, underwriting process, or branding is reproduced.**"** It is the third of this round’s four takes on **reporting only numbers someone else can recompute**, **and the only one that publishes "my model lost to a constant" as its main finding**.

Verifiable details (**all read from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **Its main finding sits at the very top and is negative** — **verbatim**: **"**Main finding:** limited policy features provide **weak predictive signal**. **Validation selected the constant mean severity baseline**; high-cost classification performs **modestly above prevalence**. This repository demonstrates **a reproducible investigation with transparent negative results, not a production insurance decision system**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things worth noting**: **"validation selected the constant mean severity baseline" means that after running model selection, what was selected was "just use the average"** (**⭐ few projects publish "every candidate model lost to a constant"; the same family as round 336’s [[inforsight]] with six generations, five failures and one success — leaving the failure in the record**); **"modestly above prevalence" reports a small margin over the base rate rather than a lift multiple**; **and its "not a production insurance decision system" mirrors the round’s other entries**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ It narrowed its own research question and wrote the reason as a data-availability judgement** — **verbatim**: **"**The original early/final-cost idea was narrowed because the public source cannot establish first-report feature timing or final settlement maturity.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **the original early-versus-final-cost idea was dropped because the public source cannot establish feature availability at first report or the maturity of final settlement** — ⭐ **precisely the two failures that recur across this site (temporal leakage and settlement maturity); and its response was to change the question rather than pretend the data supports the original one**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Its data provenance is more recomputable than most entries the site holds** — **verbatim**: **"Original `freMTPL2freq` and `freMTPL2sev` files from [CASdatasets](…), **pinned to an immutable repository revision and SHA-256 checksums**. This run uses **677,991 policies and 26,444 claim records**, linked by policy ID. **A row remains a severity record; amounts are not aggregated into policy-level losses.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: **pinned to an immutable revision with SHA-256 checksums, so anyone can confirm they hold the same bytes — the base layer of "someone else can recompute it"**; **677,991 policies and 26,444 claim records linked by policy ID**; **and "a row remains a severity record; amounts are not aggregated into policy-level losses" — a units-and-basis statement that fixes the meaning of every later metric**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Its workflow is verbatim and two of its steps are leakage controls** — **verbatim**: **"Pinned source → quality checks → SQLite → SQL join → **policy-group split** → **train-only preprocessing** → validation selection → held-out evaluation → saved pipelines → FastAPI inference"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Two things**: **splitting by policy group rather than randomly by row, so multiple claims from one policy cannot land on both sides of the split** (**the same concern round 336’s [[inforsight]] addressed with a clustered bootstrap**); **and preprocessing fitted on the training set only** — ⭐ **the two leakage sources most easily missed and least visible in the metrics**. **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ It deliberately avoids notebooks, for a very practical reason** — **verbatim**: **"**An EDA notebook is unnecessary: executable modules regenerate the summaries and plots without hidden notebook state.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **notebooks are rejected because of hidden state** (**cells can run in any order and intermediate variables live nowhere reviewable**), **and the substitute is modules plus real SQL joins plus count reconciliation** (**`sql/` and `reports/count_reconciliation.csv` are measurably present**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ Its boundary between what is committed and what is not is verbatim**: **"Raw files, joined rows, individual predictions, and trained artifacts are excluded from Git."**; **"Outcomes are **positive recorded amounts in source monetary units**; **currency and final settlement status are not independently verified**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Two things**: **the four excluded classes — raw files, joined rows, individual predictions and trained artefacts — mean conclusions and aggregate metrics are committed while anything traceable back to an individual is not**; **and it flags that outcomes are positive recorded amounts in source monetary units with currency and final settlement status not independently verified — precisely the two places insurance data analysis goes quietly wrong**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ The repository measurably holds the conclusion and reconciliation artefacts it claims** — namely **`reports/evaluation.md`, `reports/eda.json`, `reports/data_quality.json`, `reports/count_reconciliation.csv`, `reports/classification_uncertainty.json`, `reports/gamma_coefficients.csv`, `reports/high_cost_importance.csv`, and `heldout_diagnostics.png` and `training_costs.png` under `reports/figures/`**;
